comparison.objective: Candidate commissions damping by unlocking, tuning, relocking, and cycling an axis; record mechanically zeros an unpowered joint by holding a gravity-loaded link on its mark and inserting a calibration pin.
comparison.physical_skill: Both require bimanual stabilization and alignment/insertion. Candidate additionally tests hex-key seating, bounded loosening/tightening, fine rotary adjustment, re-engagement after collar motion, and iterative tuning from impacts; record tests simultaneous gravity compensation and pin-through-aligned-hole insertion into a detent.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two safe cycles within energy, speed, stroke, rebound, overload, and lock-drift constraints. Record requires pin travel ≥26 mm with joint angle within 1°, link stillness for 1 s, hands released, and no joint speed above 120°/s.
comparison.reason: The shared hold-and-insert primitive is insufficient for overlap: the record ends once a passive joint is geometrically pinned at zero, whereas the candidate must alter and verify a dynamic damping response through repeated cycles and secure the setting. Both record spec versions were read. The record has explicit numeric thresholds; candidate still lacks numeric definitions for excessive rebound, overload, witness torque, and allowed collar drift.
